title: Bump to dev versions after dance
body:
Bump the versions of the libraries to the next dev version:

c/storage  v1.65.0-dev
c/image    v5.42.0-dev
c/common   v0.70.0-dev

These will be used in versions of Podman after 6.1

<!--- Please read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/containers/container-libs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) before proceeding --->

comments.body:
> btw, is the dev bump being done on separate PRs now?

We aim to have the storage/image/common releases are on ~exactly the same codebase. (We didn’t quite get there this time, due to me not thinking ahead.)

> We aim to have the storage/image/common releases are on ~exactly the same codebase. (We didn’t quite get there this time, due to me not thinking ahead.)

actually we are, I believe Tom correctly follows the release process I suggested which means all tags are cut of the same branch (no rebases onto main)

You can diff the tags if you like https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/compare/storage/v1.64.0...common/v0.69.0 which correctly shows what I want and expect.
Oh nice; I saw the extra PR landing on main and I didn’t realize it is not going to be included in the c/common tag.
